text: A hospital cannot use a tender that is still waiting for review. Quorum helps procurement teams move from scattered documents to a clearer decision, with AI doing the preparation and people keeping control. Here is the workflow.

Start with the supplier. Their portal brings required documents into one place. Here, we open a tax registration certificate and run the AI document check. Muse Spark reads the file, identifies the document, and checks whether it matches the requested item. The result sits beside the original, so a reviewer can compare the organisation, document number, and dates. This is an advisory check. It does not certify authenticity or decide eligibility.

Now move to the officer's workspace. The tender workflow connects the notice, mandatory requirements, bid opening, and evaluation. Requirements are recorded before bids are assessed. Here, the issued matrix gives technical capability sixty percent and delivery forty percent. Evaluators can inspect the recorded scores and evidence in context. The same tender file carries forward, instead of being rebuilt across disconnected spreadsheets, messages, and folders.

Next, run the AI assisted bid review. It uses the issued criteria and every admitted bidder's submitted information. Consent is explicit, and the assessment is read only. Watch the result: both bidders are compared against the same matrix. Where the supplied documents do not establish the required contracts or a committed delivery plan, Quorum marks the criterion not evidenced. It then turns those gaps into specific questions for the committee: verify the references, confirm the delivery milestones, and check the price build up. The AI does not silently turn missing evidence into a passing score. It helps the committee focus its attention where verification matters.

Evaluation integrity stays visible alongside the review. Officers can inspect the scoring record and the checks that support it. AI advice does not write scores, rank bidders, or award the tender. The committee records its assessment, and authorised people make the decision. The broader workflow keeps award, contract, and complaint records connected to that same procurement file.

And Quorum extends beyond the workspace. We have published our MCP integration, so compatible AI clients can connect to its read only tools. The same evidence can support the tools teams already use, while decisions stay with authorised people. Quorum. The agent prepares the file. The committee awards the tender.
